title: 1 Move vs 2 Martins
summary: Simul-style challenge: Tony plays Martin on two boards at once and every turn must move the SAME PIECE TYPE on both boards (pawn on left => pawn on right). He develops one piece type at a time to provoke Martin blunders, races the 50-move rule on the right board, and finishes with a synchronized ladder mate (queen+rook) on both boards on the same move (~8:09).
rules: Two simultaneous games vs Martin (250), player is White on both.
Each turn the player makes one move on each board, and both moves must be made with the same piece type (squares may differ, e.g. Nf3 left and Ne2 right).
If a piece type has no legal move on one board it cannot be chosen (inferred).
Martin replies independently on each board.
Self-imposed: checkmate must be delivered on both boards on the same turn with the same piece type; mating on only one board counts as failure.
Normal draw rules (50-move rule) apply per board.
win_condition: Deliver checkmate on both boards on the same turn, with the same piece type.
